Both current lease liabilities are excluded; current tax accruals and mixed Other current balances remain included consistently. SBC stays expensed. Current tax payable rose $17.782B in FY2024 and fell $13.585B in FY2025, affecting this series. This qualified balance-sheet convention is not exact unlevered cash flow. FY2024 later note depreciation plus amortization exceeds cash-statement D&A by $355m; no plug is made. Forecast tax, investment and working-capital bases differ; no cross-basis FCFF CAGR or automatic calibration.
